articles.title: Congo's Ebola outbreak tops 4,000 deaths as unrest and mistrust grow
articles.summary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has recorded more than 4,000 deaths and is the fastest-growing in history. The rare Bundibugyo virus has no known treatment or vaccine, and strikes, unpaid wages and violence are hampering the response.

articles.title: Violent protests in France over education close nearly 400 schools
articles.summary: About 400 schools in France are expected to remain closed Friday after protests over teacher shortages and run-down buildings turned violent. The justice minister says 2,000 people have been arrested since the protests began.

articles.title: NASA's Crew-13 could make the fastest U.S. trip to the ISS ever
articles.summary: NASA's Crew-13 mission was set to launch Thursday and could dock at the International Space Station in 7 hours and 50 minutes, the fastest U.S. trip ever. Four crew members will spend an extended period aboard the station.
